UNIT.description: Unit System (UNIT). The single model-wide unit system; each optional field independently overrides the current force, length, heat, or temperature unit when supplied, and any omitted field keeps its existing value.

FORCE.description: Force (mass) unit. Case-insensitive. KGF=kgf, TONF=tonf, N=N, KN=kN, LBF=lbf, KIPS=kips. If omitted, the current force unit is unchanged.

DIST.description: Length/distance unit. Case-insensitive. MM=mm, CM=cm, M=m, IN=in, FT=ft. If omitted, the current length unit is unchanged.

HEAT.description: Heat unit. Case-insensitive. CAL=cal, KCAL=kcal, J=J, BTU=Btu, KJ=kJ. If omitted, the current heat unit is unchanged.

TEMPER.description: Temperature unit. Case-insensitive. C=Celsius, F=Fahrenheit. If omitted, the current temperature unit is unchanged.
